basis: 1F: outer wall faces measured to dimension ticks for 15000x8000 overall (matches labeled 15000 and 8000mm chains). Interior partitions at x=5.0m and x=10.0m (piers, from double-line wall support scan) run full building depth. Corridor bounded by two full-width walls at y=5.0m and y=3.0m (from 3000/250/1500/250/3000 mm dimension chain), each with 3 door openings measured from wall-line gaps (pixel profile of wall colour at y=618-629 and y=804-815). West wall has a recessed vestibule/porch (approx 1m deep) at the corridor width; simplified here to a flush wall with one double-width entrance door at x=0 spanning the corridor width (y=3.25-4.75), matching the West elevation door (height evidenced 0-2.1m). South wall of the SW office has a small wall notch/chamfer (~0.3m) around its entrance; simplified to a flush wall with a single door (matches 540/900mm bottom dimension and South elevation door 0-2.1m). Windows measured from cyan hatch band extents on each facade; north/south office windows read from 2400mm-module dimension chain, corridor windows on east/west from 1200mm dimension chain.
